From the judge's explanation

To both parties: this dispute is about the $5.00 waiting-time line on trip TRP-02740 (fare_breakdown.waiting_time_fee 5.00; platform_policy.waiting_fee_sgd 5.00), not a no-show cancellation fee. The trip was completed, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against total_charged 33.23. The contested amount is $5.00.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 5.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties: this dispute is about the $5.00 waiting-time line on trip TRP-02740 (fare_breakdown.waiting_time_fee 5.00; platform_policy.waiting_fee_sgd 5.00), not a no-show cancellation fee. The trip was completed, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against total_charged 33.23. The contested amount is $5.00. The driver's arrival is genuine, and I say so: the 'I'm Here' tap at 2026-09-03T09:11:59 is matched by 11 qualifying GPS fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius starting at the same second, with the driver stationary and the trace closing to well under a metre of the pin. POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-05 is not met (the driver was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor moving at 15 km/h or more), so no false-arrival referral is entered against the driver. The charge fails on its own condition. Under POL-NS-10(d) a waiting-time fee is chargeable only where the trip was completed AND the driver's in-geofence dwell before the rider boarded, measured as POL-NS-01(c) measures it (from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap), exceeded the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180). It did not. The measured dwell is 100 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 09:11:59 to the trip start at 09:13:39, giving a shortfall of 80 seconds recorded on the trace; the trip record's own wait timer (09:12:01 to 09:13:39, 98 seconds) and its wait_time_min of 1.7 minutes agree. There is only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1) and no admissible traffic advisory to permit any accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) — EV-ADVIS-02740-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), which makes limb (i) unavailable rather than excusing anything. Both advocates' claims on these points are answered together: the driver's claims that arrival is verified, that the marker is not false, that the amount itself is the platform's published $5.00 figure and not a figure the driver selected, that no billing-integrity defect of the kind POL-NS-08(d) describes arises, that no POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance goodwill applies (a single registered pickup point, rider track within 7.4 m of the pin), and that no anti-farming pattern exists (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against completed_trips_30d 67) are all accepted.
